details: Bitcoin dropped 3.1% over the last 24 hours to approximately $62,702, marking its lowest level since July 9. This decline followed Strategy's announcement of plans to sell up to $5 billion worth of Bitcoin to bolster cash reserves and potentially fund stock repurchases, alongside its weaker-than-expected quarterly earnings report.
title: Bitcoin Hits 3-Week Low as Strategy Plans $5 Billion BTC Sale

details: Bitcoin losses attributed to a security vulnerability in Coldcard wallets have reportedly increased to $70 million, according to analysis by Galaxy Research. Attackers are believed to have deliberately targeted high-value wallets in the exploit.
title: Coldcard Vulnerability Causes $70 Million Bitcoin Loss

details: The CLARITY Act, a crucial U.S. crypto market-structure bill, is encountering significant obstacles, with its passage by the Senate before the August recess appearing improbable. While President Trump reviews a bipartisan ethics proposal tied to the Act, prediction markets indicate only a 28% chance of it becoming law in 2026, contributing to price volatility in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP.
title: CLARITY Act Faces Hurdles, Senate Passage Unlikely Before Recess

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced a substantial net outflow of $265.4 million on July 31, with BlackRock's IBIT alone accounting for $122.7 million. Conversely, Ethereum ETFs recorded a net inflow of $9 million, primarily driven by ETHB with $15.4 million in inflows. Despite overall positive inflows for Bitcoin ETFs in July, the month concluded with investor caution.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Large Outflows, Ethereum ETFs Record Inflows on July 31

details: A recent report by Wintermute reveals that institutional investors were responsible for approximately 72% of spot crypto trading volume in the first half of 2026, a notable increase from 61% in the latter half of 2025. This growing institutional participation is contributing to a more mature and less volatile crypto market, as professional investors tend to hold positions longer and operate within defined risk parameters.
title: Institutional Investors Drive 72% of Spot Crypto Trading, Reducing Volatility

details: Ethereum (ETH) concluded July with impressive 20.3% gains, marking its strongest monthly performance in a year and recovering a significant portion of June's losses. However, ETH entered August under pressure, slipping below $1,900. Derivatives activity has slowed, and there's uncertainty surrounding its ability to reclaim the $1,900 level and push towards $2,000.
title: Ethereum Posts 20.3% Gains in July, Faces $1,900 Hurdle in August

details: The Russian government has implemented a ban on cryptocurrency mining in Moscow, Moscow Oblast, and eight districts of Kursk Oblast. The restriction takes effect on August 15 and is slated to last until December 31, 2032, expanding upon previous mining regulations.
title: Russia Bans Crypto Mining in Moscow and Other Regions Until 2032

details: Decentralized exchange Uniswap has introduced a new "Earn" feature in collaboration with Morpho, enabling users to generate yield from their idle crypto assets. This initiative aims to enhance earning opportunities within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.
title: Uniswap Launches 'Earn' With Morpho for Yield on Idle Assets
